description: DEAL v1.2 promotion gate (ISSUE-0107): intentionally unsupported v1.2 cases for the JVM backend-runtime gate. Every case names its tracked follow-up issue in 'knownFail'; when the tracked issue lands and the case passes, the runner fails with a promotion instruction. ISSUE-0106 promoted jvm-unicode-scalar-string-length (the JVM backend now measures std/string length in Unicode scalar values; the passing pins live in jvm-v12-slice.json).

tests.name: jvm-int32-literal-out-of-range
tests.description: v1.2 signed 32-bit int: the literal 2147483648 outside the unary-minus position is a compile-time error (E1036)

tests.name: jvm-int32-add-overflow
tests.description: v1.2 signed 32-bit int: 2147483647 + 1 raises E8004 at runtime

tests.name: jvm-bytes-buffer-ops
tests.description: v1.2 bytes: bytes(4) allocates a zero-filled buffer; b[0] = 255; b.length is 4
